environment: GTK 4.14.5 / Pango 1.52.1 / private Xvfb (800x600, and 1280x800 for the preview panel), Metacity and D-Bus / Cairo, and GL (Mesa llvmpipe) for the second native view pass and gl-shadow
native_view: ASan + UBSan, once under the Cairo renderer (no shadow margin) and once under GL (shadow margin): path fitting (including distinguishing prefixes), file-type icons, entrance, kind and child classes, group headers, the page header and its clock, idle strip states and fitting, placeholder tips, the Copy path confirmation, highlight geometry and an observed glide, opening/closing timers, spinner and launch state, the shadow margin against the display, renderer and window size, forced GTK_THEME dark and high contrast, the preview panel (waiting for rest, details read by its worker, in-place updates, narrow and cleared states, destruction while reading), 300-character paste, fixed geometry and timer destruction passed
font_behavior: Schibsted Grotesk and Bedstead from the stylesheet (installed in the user's font directory; stand-ins Ubuntu Sans and Ubuntu Sans Mono) at the desktop font's size (GTK default size on the private display)
limits: Native view disables LeakSanitizer for process-global GTK/font caches; ASan and UBSan remain enabled.
X11 placement tested on private display; Wayland placement remains compositor-controlled.
Motion is verified by state and geometry checks plus frame captures; perceived smoothness depends on the compositor.
Timing samples are acceptance observations, not a production performance budget.

The shadow margin and its input region are exercised under GL emulated by Mesa llvmpipe (gl-shadow); its timings measure that software GL, not a GPU. The target desktop's NVIDIA GL and Muffin compositor were not part of these runs.

The preview panel is exercised on a 1280x800 private screen (wide_preview) under the Cairo renderer. In alternating runs there, the median input-to-results paint was about 38-41 ms for the 880-pixel popup with its panel, 32 ms for an 880-pixel list without it and 29 ms for the 680-pixel list; the extra cost is software drawing of the wider window and the panel's text. GPU rendering was not measured.
